DISCUSS: 10 Thoughts From the Sidelines: Florida 52, Ole Miss 28
Photographer Chris Spears had the best seat in The Swamp. Ten things the sideline told him about the Florida team that ran over No. 4 Ole Miss.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/chris-spears-10-thoughts-from-the-sidelines-florida-ole-miss
By Chris Spears. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
